title: test-utils loopback bypass in is_valid_mailbox_host is the correct pattern
description: #[cfg(feature = test-utils)] bypass for ip.is_loopback() in is_valid_mailbox_host is the correct way to enable integration test harnesses while keeping the production IP-range enforcement intact. This is not a weakened security check — loopback is unreachable from any peer in production, and the cfg gate ensures the bypass is never compiled into release builds.
